dedupe_keys.name: alberta irrigation information annual irrigation district statistics 1992 2025

description: Alberta Irrigation Information is an annual statistical booklet that Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation produced for each year from 1992 to 2025, with most annual data supplied by the province's irrigation districts. The 2025 edition has 20 tables on the irrigation districts: crops grown, on-farm irrigation methods, assessed and actually irrigated acres over the last 30 years, irrigation rates, energy types, expansion limits and water licence allocations, gross annual diversions, the water balance, types of conveyance infrastructure, infrastructure length and replacement cost, district reservoirs, provincially owned reservoirs in the South Saskatchewan River Basin and hydroelectric plants on irrigation infrastructure, plus private irrigation licences and climate tables. Coverage is the irrigation districts of southern Alberta and private irrigation across the province. Every edition is a free download as PDF from open.alberta.ca under the Open Government Licence - Alberta, which does not cover third-party material in the booklets; a crop area assessment for 2007 to 2015 is also published as XLSX. Caveats: the tables are in PDF, units are imperial (acres, acre-feet), and district amalgamations (2022 and 2023) change the list of districts between editions. Simulation uses: district-level canal and pipeline lengths, replacement costs, diversions and reservoir storage for capacity planning and drought adaptation of irrigation networks. Related records: the FAO Global Map of Irrigation Areas (data-fao-global-map-of-irrigation-areas).
